children: Hong Kong, September 09, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has revised the outlook on Health and Happiness International Holdings Limited to positive from stable. At the same time, we have affirmed H&H's Ba3 corporate family rating and senior secured rating.  "The positive outlook and rating affirmation reflects H&H's faster-than-expected deleveraging, driven by the company's strong earnings growth and debt reduction supported by robust cash flow generation.

title: Moody's Ratings revises outlook on Health and Happiness to positive from stable; affirms Ba3 ratings
